verdict.rationale: Smithery has a dedicated Vercel AI SDK integration page showing that it handles OAuth and connection management and can aggregate tools from multiple servers. It also generates a typed TypeScript SDK for each published server, and its REST interface lets developers avoid implementing MCP directly. Only one of the named frameworks is evidenced, so the story is roughly half delivered. Missing for 10: documented adapters for LangChain, CrewAI, the OpenAI SDK and the Anthropic SDK, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.
